item.title: 【UPSCALED】Dr. Dre Feat Snoop Dogg - Still D.R.E. [1999] (Official Video) 25fps 2160p 4k
item.description:
The POWER of Video AI
ASUS ROG Astral GeForce RTX™ 5090, 32GB GDDR7, 512-bit
Video Comparison is in 60fps because my graphics cars is setted to record at 60fps.
QTGMC *Placebo* (best de-interlace ever) to Deinterlace and cutting unwanted black borders and resize it to 576p (4:3).
Topaz v1.7.0.2.b Starlight Precise 2.6 x2, Smoothness #3.
Topaz Nyx XL with Recovery Details at 100, original resolution from Step 1 Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 x3 .
Topaz Artemis Aliasing And Moire to increase resolution to 2160p with Recovery Details at 100.
Codec settings: Output type - Video, Codec - DNxHR, Profile - 444, Audio Mode - Copy, Container - Mov. (For Every Topaz Steps).
Then with the result Handbrake to make it from MOV to MP4 bitrate 12.000 (best quality options setting Handbrake).
Then VideoReDo - FINAL STEP.
